**Company Description**
**NEC Software Solutions (India)**
On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.
  
  
We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.
  
  
We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two-person startups to $bn listed companies.
  
  
For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.
  
  
**Job Description**
Front-End Developer (.NET 10+, Blazor)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Front-End Developer to design and develop modern, responsive and intuitive user interfaces for our next-generation applications.
  
  
The successful candidate will have a strong background in web UI development, user experience implementation and modern front-end engineering practices. Working closely with designers, architects, back-end developers and business stakeholders, you will help translate designs and user requirements into high-quality, accessible and maintainable web applications.
  
  
Our front-end platform is built using modern .NET technologies, including Blazor, and we are looking for developers who are passionate about creating excellent user experiences and clean, maintainable code. Whilst experience with Blazor is highly desirable, we are equally interested in developers with strong front-end engineering skills who are keen to develop expertise in modern .NET UI technologies.
  
  
The team embraces AI-assisted software development and modern engineering practices, providing opportunities to work with contemporary tools and technologies while influencing the future direction of our applications.
  
  
**Essential Skills**
User Interface Development
  
  

* Strong commercial experience developing modern web-based user interfaces
* Excellent understanding of front-end development principles and best practices
* Experience building responsive, accessible and user-friendly applications
* Strong understanding of component-based UI development
* Ability to translate design concepts into high-quality production-ready interfaces
* Experience building reusable UI components and patterns
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering polished user experiences

HTML, CSS & Styling
  
  

* Advanced HTML5 skills
* Strong CSS3 skills
* Experience using SASS/SCSS
* Experience creating responsive layouts across desktop, tablet and mobile devices
* Strong understanding of modern CSS techniques and layout approaches
* Experience troubleshooting browser compatibility issues
* Understanding of web accessibility standards and best practices (WCAG)

Design Collaboration
  
  

* Experience working closely with UI/UX designers
* Experience implementing designs from Figma
* Ability to interpret design systems, component libraries and design specifications
* Understanding of user experience principles and usability considerations
* Appreciation for visual consistency and user-centered design

API Integration & Modern Development
  
  

* Experience consuming and integrating REST/JSON APIs
* Strong C# development skills
* Experience working within modern application architecture
* Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts
* Ability to troubleshoot and debug complex application issues

Engineering Practices
  
  

* Experience using Git and modern source control workflows
* Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code
* Experience participating in peer code reviews
* Experience working within Agile development environments
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

AI-Assisted Development
  
  

* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot
* Ability to utilize AI tools to improve productivity and accelerate development
* Experience validating and reviewing AI-generated code
* Understanding of responsible AI-assisted development practices
* Ability to balance AI-assisted delivery with appropriate testing, quality and security controls

Key Responsibilities
  
  
User Interface Development
  
  

* Design, develop and maintain modern web application user interfaces
* Build reusable, maintainable and accessible UI components
* Deliver responsive experiences across multiple devices and screen sizes
* Implement designs and user journeys from Figma and other design artefacts
* Ensure high standards of usability, accessibility and visual quality

Technical Delivery
  
  

* Develop front-end application features using modern .NET technologies
* Integrate with REST/JSON APIs and back-end services
* Contribute to application architecture and technical design discussions
* Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and performance issues
* Produce robust, maintainable and scalable solutions

Quality & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Participate in code reviews and technical peer reviews
* Identify opportunities for refactoring and technical debt reduction
* Contribute to coding standards and development best practices
* Promote accessibility, usability and responsive design principles
* Support continuous improvement of processes, tooling and development methodologies

AI & Modern Engineering Practices
  
  

* Utilize AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality
* Validate AI-generated code and implementation recommendations
* Share knowledge and best practices relating to AI-assisted development
* Support adoption of modern engineering approaches across the team

Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with designers, architects, back-end developers and stakeholders
* Participate in estimation, planning and sprint activities
* Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing
* Collaborate with UX and design teams to continuously enhance user experiences

Desirable Skills
  
  
Modern .NET UI Development
  
  

* Experience developing applications using Blazor
* Experience with .NET 8/9/10+
* Experience building server-side or client-side web applications using modern .NET technologies
* Familiarity with component-based architecture

UI Frameworks & Tooling
  
  

* Experience with Telerik UI for Blazor
* Experience working with design systems and reusable component libraries
* Experience developing complex, data-driven business applications

Front-End Technologies
  
  

* JavaScript experience
* Experience integrating third-party JavaScript libraries where required
* Understanding of browser performance optimization techniques

Architecture & Design Patterns
  
  

* Experience working with CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)
* Understanding of domain-driven design principles
* Familiarity with event-driven architecture
* Experience designing scalable enterprise applications

Cloud & DevOps
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure
* Experience with Azure DevOps
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
* Familiarity with monitoring and telemetry tools

Testing
  
  

* Experience with automated UI testing frameworks
* Experience with component and integration testing
* Familiarity with Test-Driven Development (TDD)

Technology Landscape
  
  
Our front-end platform is built using modern Microsoft technologies, with a strong focus on .NET, Blazor, reusable component design and high-quality user experiences.
  
  
We work closely with designers using Figma and place significant emphasis on creating intuitive, accessible and visually consistent applications. Developers are encouraged to contribute not only to implementation but also to improvements in user experience, design standards and front-end architecture.
  
  
Whilst Blazor is a key part of our technology strategy, we recognize that excellent front-end engineering skills are more important than knowledge of any specific framework. We welcome developers with strong UI development experience who are excited to learn and work with modern .NET technologies.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
You'll join a team building modern business applications using contemporary technologies, modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development tools.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to work closely with designers, influence user experience decisions, develop highly visible business applications and help shape the future direction of our front-end platform. We value strong UI engineering, continuous learning and a pragmatic approach to adopting new technologies, giving you the chance to work with modern .NET, Blazor and AI-powered development practices while continuing to grow your skills.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Any graduate

title: API Integration Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Privacient is a modern privacy awareness and implementation platform that helps organizations move beyond complex, unused policy documents. The company focuses on making privacy accessible and engaging, ensuring that policies and practices are clearly understood across all levels of an organization. Privacient’s solutions are designed to support effective, real-world privacy implementations that reach the last mile, where employees interact with data every day. By combining technology, education, and practical frameworks, Privacient enables businesses to strengthen compliance while building a culture of privacy.

Experience: 4+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced API Integration Engineer with strong expertise in REST APIs, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and web technologies. The ideal candidate will help clients integrate APIs into their existing systems, understand their technical requirements, and recommend efficient, scalable, and reliable implementation approaches.

The candidate should have a deep understanding of how APIs work, hands-on experience with frontend and/or backend technologies, and the ability to troubleshoot integration challenges and optimize the way APIs and external scripts are implemented within web applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with clients to understand their technical requirements and help integrate APIs with their existing applications, websites, and backend systems.
* Analyze API documentation and translate business and technical requirements into practical implementation approaches.
* Implement, test, debug, and troubleshoot REST API integrations across different systems.
* Work with HTTP requests and responses, JSON payloads, headers, query parameters, status codes, and API error handling.
* Develop and troubleshoot web integrations using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Optimize the loading and execution of JavaScript files and third-party scripts to minimize their impact on website performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve API integration efficiency, reduce unnecessary network requests, and optimize request-response handling.
* Diagnose integration issues using browser developer tools, network inspection, server logs, and API testing tools.
* Collaborate with client technical teams and internal engineering teams to resolve implementation challenges.
* Provide technical guidance on API usage, integration workflows, implementation dependencies, and best practices.
* Test integrations across different environments and ensure functionality, reliability, and compatibility with existing systems.
* Document implementation steps, troubleshooting procedures, and recommendations for future integrations.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in API integration, web development, or a related software engineering role.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, request-response lifecycles, HTTP methods, status codes, headers, JSON, and error handling.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Practical experience integrating APIs with frontend applications, backend services, or third-party platforms.
* Understanding of JavaScript execution, asynchronous operations, Promises, async/await, and dynamic script loading.
* Hands-on experience optimizing script loading using techniques such as async, defer, and dynamic script injection.
* Proficiency in using Postman or similar tools for API testing and debugging.
* Experience using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, debug JavaScript issues, and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Understanding of CORS, browser behavior, cookies, caching, and common web integration challenges.
* Experience working with at least one frontend or backend technology, such as React, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Python, or Go.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience integrating third-party JavaScript libraries, SDKs, widgets, and external services into client websites.
* Experience working directly with clients on technical implementations and integration troubleshooting.
* Understanding of website performance optimization, browser rendering, lazy loading, and reducing render-blocking resources.
* Experience interpreting technical documentation and independently developing integration solutions.
* Ability to assess different implementation approaches and recommend the most efficient solution based on the client's existing architecture.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Has a deep, practical understanding of APIs and can explain how to integrate them efficiently into different systems.
* Can independently review API documentation, identify dependencies, and implement integrations with minimal supervision.
* Understands how JavaScript scripts are loaded and executed in browsers and how they affect website performance.
* Can identify the root cause of API failures, integration conflicts, and performance issues.
* Is comfortable communicating with clients, understanding their technical environments, and guiding them through implementation.
* Can balance functionality, performance, maintainability, and compatibility when recommending integration approaches.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.
